name: hermes-bridge
description: Gives the Hermes assistant (Jarvis) hands in VS Code over a local MCP server: open projects and files, read the active editor and selection, diagnostics, run editor commands.

hermesBridge.port.description: Local port of the MCP server (127.0.0.1).

hermesBridge.remoteHost.description: Remote-SSH host for project paths starting with / (empty = local folders).
